prompt: Photorealistic product rendering of solar cold store for 1 tonne produce, shown as section cutaway at work on plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop. Center: 2m thick white foam sandwich-panel cold box with front cut away to reveal interior, anchored to raised grey concrete plinth. Inside: two low steel side racks with centre aisle, stacked vented light food-grade crates full of fresh produce, high evaporator with small fan. Front: single insulated hinged door with seal, shown closed beside cut opening, door height to adult chest. Outside shaded beside box: compact steel DC chiller unit with condenser. Beside box: dark battery controller cabinet on plinth with copper DC wiring to chiller. Separate to side: fixed-tilt rack with six dark blue monocrystalline panels tilted to sun. Include one standing adult beside door for true scale of 5m overall span; scale person is only extra. Small patch of concrete ground under plinth cut cleanly to backdrop, no landscape. Real materials, product-shot softbox lighting, mechanism readable, fixed panels and plinth vs moving air and door swing. Show energy flow PV to battery to chiller to box interior and cool air mixing over crates. Clean legible callouts on small light tags in empty space with thin leader lines to each focus part: Solar Panel Array, Battery Control Cabinet, DC Chiller Unit, Insulated Cold Box, Vented Produce Crates, Insulated Hinged Door, Concrete Support Plinth. No other text, no margins, no scale bars.

printed values or labels beyond callouts

Door on front face. Right-rear outside: chiller and battery cabinet adjacent to box wall in shade. Left-rear separate: tilted PV array on low steel rack. Adult person standing at door side for scale, head above door mid-height, box about taller than person
visual_plan.operating_moment: Sunny daytime holding operation with full produce load present, chiller running steady, fan mixing air through crate vents, door sealed shut, battery charging while powering cooling
visual_plan.transfer_path: Energy: PV array -> Battery cabinet -> DC chiller -> cold box interior; Measured: box air sensor in crate gap -> thermostat switching chiller
visual_plan.interactions: PV rack stands separate from box to reduce wind load; battery cabinet feeds chiller by cable; chiller blows cold through high evaporator fan over vented crates; crates sit 3-high on side racks with air gaps; racks stand free on plinth; box anchored to plinth; door seals box wall
